As Bank Of America Co (BAC) Share Price Declined, United American Securities Boosted Stake by $2.17 Million; Wafra Investment Advisory Group Trimmed Holding in Taiwan Semiconductor Adr 87403 (TSM) by $412,074 
April 24, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson 
Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc decreased its stake in Taiwan Semiconductor Adr 87403 (TSM) by 13.44% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc sold 10,566 shares as the company’s stock rose 9.24% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 68,078 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.70M, down from 78,644 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc who had been investing in Taiwan Semiconductor Adr 87403 for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $200.79B market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $38.76. About 3.39 million shares traded. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has risen 30.51% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 18.96% the S&P500. 
United American Securities Inc increased its stake in Bank Of America Corporation Co (BAC) by 365.28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. United American Securities Inc bought 74,700 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 95,150 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.81M, up from 20,450 at the end of the previous reported quarter. United American Securities Inc who had been investing in Bank Of America Corporation Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $314.46 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.44% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $30.76. About 19.43 million shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 28.18% since April 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.63% the S&P500. 
Wafra Investment Advisory Group Inc, which manages about $7.55 billion and $2.19 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) by 2,570 shares to 208,332 shares, valued at $29.11M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 24,710 shares in the quarter, for a total of 245,988 shares, and has risen its stake in Illumina Inc. (NASDAQ:ILMN). 
Among 8 analysts covering Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing ( NYSE:TSM ), 4 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 4 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing had 17 analyst reports since August 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by HSBC on Wednesday, June 21 to “Hold”. The stock of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (NYSE:TSM) has “Outperform” rating given on Friday, December 11 by Credit Suisse. On Monday, November 27 the stock rating was downgraded by Morgan Stanley to “Equal-Weight”. On Tuesday, March 13 the stock rating was maintained by Susquehanna with “Hold”. As per Tuesday, October 4, the company rating was upgraded by Susquehanna. On Thursday, April 19 the stock rating was maintained by Susquehanna with “Hold”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, October 10 by J.P. Morgan. The firm earned “Sector Weight” rating on Friday, October 14 by Pacific Crest. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Wednesday, September 6 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. 
Among 33 analysts covering Bank of America ( NYSE:BAC ), 22 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 67% are positive. Bank of America had 113 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Keefe Bruyette & Woods maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Tuesday, October 3 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Jefferies on Monday, October 10. The rating was maintained by Wells Fargo with “Buy” on Wednesday, December 20. As per Tuesday, June 6, the company rating was maintained by Jefferies. The stock of Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) earned “Buy” rating by Sandler O’Neill on Wednesday, January 20. The rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets with “Hold” on Wednesday, April 12. The stock has “Hold” rating by Robert W. Baird on Tuesday, October 31. Robert W. Baird maintained it with “Hold” rating and $24.0 target in Friday, August 25 report. The rating was downgraded by Keefe Bruyette & Woods to “Market Perform” on Monday, May 16.
